desc: With the Mesa FFT Titanium, shooters can experience one of the lightest steel-barreled rifles ever built. The compact hunting rifle features a featherlight contour stainless steel barrel with a bead blasted finish and a removable seamless radial brake. The natural carbon fiber FFT Sporter stock is finished with satin metallic gray accents for a striking look. The Mesa FFT Titanium Edition weighs in starting at 5.1 pounds and is backed by the Christensen Arms Sub-MOA Guarantee.
